manager.name: Steam Workshop + EU5's in-game mod manager (playsets)

intro: Ten of the most-subscribed Europa Universalis V mods on the Steam Workshop, all updated within the past few months. Subscribe on the Workshop, then add them to a playset in the game's mod manager in this order. Each badge is that mod's own live status for the current game version, from its Workshop update date and version tags.

mods.name: Community Mod Framework (CMF)
mods.summary: Shared mod menu and scripting tools many EU5 mods hook into, to improve compatibility between mods.
mods.note: Its author says to load it first in your playset.

mods.name: Glorp UI
mods.summary: Interface overhaul with colour-coded icons, a customisable map-mode bar and per-save UI settings.
mods.note: Integrates with CMF's mod menu. Mods placed after it in the playset override its changes.

mods.name: Cheat Menu Pro
mods.summary: In-game cheat menu with tools for countries, government and laws, geopolitics, trade and religious orders.

mods.name: Better Road Builder
mods.summary: Shows roads and rivers together in the Roads and Road Builder map modes.
mods.note: Its author lists it as achievement compatible and save safe.

mods.name: Construction Manager
mods.summary: Automates construction: auto-expand buildings and RGOs, auto-upgrade, auto-build and auto-food.
mods.note: Lists Community Mod Framework as a required item on the Workshop.

mods.name: Thick borders
mods.summary: Black, thicker country borders and province borders that stay visible from further away.
mods.note: Its author lists it as Ironman and achievement compatible.

mods.name: Free Console Access
mods.summary: Toggles debug mode (and the console) with a shortcut, Shift+F10 by default.
mods.note: Its author says to put it at the bottom of your playset, after UI mods such as Glorp UI.

mods.name: National Destinies - Formables Content
mods.summary: Events, advances, missions and units for 149 formable countries, including 39 new formables.

mods.name: Basileia Romaion 1337
mods.summary: Alternate-history overhaul set in 1337 in which the Medieval Roman Empire survived in Anatolia.
mods.note: A total overhaul: don't combine it with other big overhauls.

mods.name: MEIOU and Taxes
mods.summary: Economy overhaul: RGOs become buildings, estates share building upkeep and climates follow Köppen.
mods.note: Its team calls the Workshop version an initial test release and takes bug reports on its Discord.
